text: The stable-lad at the carriage door
why: ¶169 says one of the stable-lads held the carriage door open for them. The label only describes him by that role and gives no name.

text: Thursday evening, stepping into the carriage, Holmes turns to a stable-lad
why: The story has Holmes and Watson arrive in Tavistock on Thursday (¶13 says it is Thursday morning, and ¶47 has them reach Tavistock that evening). They then visit the trainer's house and Mapleton, and ¶169 has Holmes turn to a stable-lad as they step into the carriage. The label's time and action both follow from the text.
